# Pao Studio

> Pao Studio is an independent product and content studio. It operates Pao Pool on Cardano and experiments with non-custodial delegation as an optional supporter and membership relationship.

This file is a machine-readable discovery index. The linked public HTML pages remain the canonical source of page content. Cardano staking rewards vary and are not guaranteed.

## Core entities

- [Pao Studio](https://www.bubble-studio.xyz/about): The organization publishing these resources. Earlier public pages and the domain also use the alternate name Bubble Studio.
- [Martin / 0xMartin](https://www.bubble-studio.xyz/about#martin): The author of most Pao Studio articles and the public identity connected to the linked GitHub and X profiles.
- [Pao Pool](https://www.bubble-studio.xyz/staking#pao-pool): The Cardano stake pool operated by Pao Studio.
- Pao Pool ID: `pool1jh5p5627hzqxdzjutfenz83qs7p2qtha4kvst3hs0829sdc0ksm`
- [Pao Pool on CardanoScan](https://cardanoscan.io/pool/pool1jh5p5627hzqxdzjutfenz83qs7p2qtha4kvst3hs0829sdc0ksm): Current independently verifiable pool data.
- [Pao Pool on Cexplorer](https://cexplorer.io/pool/pool1jh5p5627hzqxdzjutfenz83qs7p2qtha4kvst3hs0829sdc0ksm): Pool identity and delegation explorer.
